main_text.l: SECT. I.
Vinculi illius sive ligaminis, quod qui
jurat ligat super animam suam,
& de quo tam multa hactenus differuimus,
Solutio hodiernum pensum est, & totius
propositæ tractationis novissima pars.
De qua solutione, antequam ad species
descendatur, duo sunt in genere obser-
vanda. Observandum primo; vinculi so-
lutionem peculiarem esse juramento pro-
missorio, in assertorio locum non ha-
bere. Omni Juramento, sive Assertorio,
sive promissorio, debet inesse Veritas:
sed cum hoc discrimine, quod ad jura-
mentum Assertorium unica sufficiat veri-
tas de præsenti, cum in Promissorio du-
plex requiratur; una sc. de præsenti, al-
tera de futuro. Veritas de præsenti re-
spicit ipsum actum jurandi: & consistit
in hoc, ut jurans quando jurat verum di-
cat; hoc est, ut mens sit congrua verbis,
& ut habeat intentionem servandi id

page.notes: The catchword "quod" stands alone at the lower right and is therefore not repeated in the text. The left margin shows only edge marks and a dark strip from the scan border, which are not printed text. The first line of the page (the running head) and the page number 297 are printed as shown. The opening "V" is a large initial and is joined to "inculi" as "Vinculi". The "Cautiones" line break is read as one word from the two printed fragments "Cau-" and "tiones.".
